                  Change involving the adding of certain OCBC cards* to Google Wallet™From 31 July 2025, you will no longer be able to add OCBC cards* to Google Wallet™ using SMS One-Time Passwords (OTPs). Step 5: Return to the Google Wallet™ app to finish adding your card. For added convenience, set the card as your default card for payment. * Excludes business credit/debit cards.
